scoring_justification: All scored quantities (G, E, σ, ζ, A, B/G, Cauchy pressure, ductility classifications) are recomputed from the agent's raw elastic constants using closed-form formulas; no self‑reported numbers are trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for derived mechanical properties of SrPdH₃ and SrLiH₃ (PBE‑GGA) from paper Table 2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper (International Journal of Modern Physics B, 2016).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported numbers; the checker recomputes from the agent's elastic constants and compares, ensuring the reproduction target is the paper's own result.

outputs.description: Computed elastic constants C11, C12, C44 for the cubic perovskite hydrides SrLiH3 and SrPdH3. The verifier will recompute all derived mechanical properties (shear modulus, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, anisotropy, Kleinman parameter, B/G ratio, Cauchy pressure) from these constants and compare against the paper's reported PBE‑GGA values.

output_contract.notes: The electronic band gap, DOS at Fermi level, Debye temperature, pressure-dependent elastic constants, and quasi-harmonic thermal properties are headline quantities in the paper but are not scored here. They require either an additional DFT band-structure/DOS run at the same level (electronic), the Gibbs program for quasi-harmonic Debye modeling (thermal vs T/P), or many extra DFT runs (pressure-dependent elastic constants). They can be addressed in a follow‑up package.
